title: The sponsor wants the hardest use case first
prompt: The highest-value candidate is also the most complex. What do you recommend?

options.text: Stage it, and lead with a high-value, lower-complexity agent to establish the pattern and the baseline.
options.feedback: Correct. The matrix exists to allocate resources by return, and successful agents become templates for future development.

options.text: Build the hardest one first to prove ambition.
options.feedback: That ignores the prioritization framework and risks the programme on the least predictable build.

options.text: Decline the engagement until complexity drops.
options.feedback: No. High value with high complexity is a staging decision, not a refusal.
